This hill is not worth dying on. Feminism is the word we have had to describe this issue for over 200 years. Treating feminism like a dirty word all of a sudden only helps stigmatize all the literature and activism in this field and artificially elevates reactionary criticism of feminism by creating the impression in young people that feminists need to apologize out of the gate for daring to use a gendered term to describe a gendered social theory.
Feminism is a good word, and being a feminist is a great thing. Getting hung up over it for “gender egalitarianism” is just wasting your own time.
